Three steps, and no fee to join. You set your own rates and keep what you bill.

2. ### Get your partner code

3. ### Bring your clients

Ask our team and partners on the partner Discord.

Twenty gives you the kind of flexibility that actually changes what you can offer your clients. The dev experience is clean, the APIs are open, and when something needs to be customized, you can just do it. There's no fighting the platform.
The flexibility is just amazing. Literally, there's nothing you cannot do. You can create objects, access everything through the API, pull notes and send them to the portal. Try doing that in HubSpot. No way. It's the true ability to build exactly what's actually needed.

title: AI FAQ
snippet:
On the Pro and Organization plans, AI chat and web search first use each member’s personal AI usage, a weekly allowance included in the plan. After that, and for AI agents in workflows, AI actions consume workspace credits based on the complexity of the task and the AI model used.

key.On a self-hosted instance, the built-in providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI) work on every plan, Free included. Set the matching API key (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`) in **Settings → Admin Panel → Configuration Variables**, or in your `.env` followed by a server restart. The models then appear under **Settings → Admin Panel → AI**.Custom providers (custom endpoints, private gateways, OpenAI-compatible or local models, extra regions), added under **Settings → Admin Panel → AI → Custom Providers**, are currently complimentary up to 25 seats. Above that, an Organization plan is required. The AI section of the admin panel states where your instance stands.

title: Permissions
snippet: On Twenty Cloud, creating and assigning custom roles to members or API keys requires the **Organization** plan. On **Pro**, members use the built-in **Admin** and **Member** roles; AI agents can have custom roles on any plan. **Pro (Early)** plans retain custom roles, and self-hosted instances include them on every plan.
